success_criteria: Recover numerical source free energy, exact representation/objective normalization, original branch coverage and historical runtime recipe.
Recover independently observed original DyNeMo training-trajectory loss; do not substitute post-fit free_energy() computed from final weights.
Preserve original cohort and fixed model capacity; never average incomparable HMM, DyNeMo, burst and static objectives into a victory score.
Predeclare an effect, uncertainty and equal access/compute policy including all attempted runs.

Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

data_contract.neural: Per-participant multichannel source time series in networks/subjectXX.npy; separate single-channel bursts series. Author recipe: 250 Hz, 38-parcel Giles atlas.

data_contract.split: Reproduction uses author cohort. Extension freezes participant splits before fitting PCA/state models; repeated seeds assessed without choosing on held-out age effects.
data_contract.controls: Stationary surrogate preserving spectra; matched static covariance baseline; participant-level permutation and resampling; separate state label matching from substantive neural interpretation.
